card.name: Words before 'proposed' injection site
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'the', 'at' or 'in the region' just before an expected word like 'proposed' or 'intended' in injection-site or treatment-site infection warnings. Also fires on words in 'test patients' or 'screen all individuals' before a purpose phrase.

modes.label: Infection at proposed site
modes.description: Linking words right before 'proposed injection site' in contraindication text.
modes.example: In the presence of infection<< at>> the proposed injection site(s).

modes.label: Screening or testing instructions
modes.description: Words after 'test', 'screen' or 'patients' where a purpose clause such as 'before use' is expected.
modes.example: Screen all<< individuals>> for HIV-1 infection prior to initiating

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words like 'intended', 'desired' and 'planned' as the next word.
card.plain: It fires on the small words just before 'proposed' or 'intended' in warnings about infection at the injection site or screening before treatment.
